title: 第9章考核开始
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
十二天一晃就没了。

    最后这几天陈青山什么也没干。白天正常干活，晚上关门休息，把修为压住，把状态养好。后天搬的那两口箱子还在识海里静静躺着，他不急着处理。

    大考当天。

    “今天大考，别掉链子。”

    天还没亮，赵铁手就站在陈青山门口，手里拎着个水壶，脸上的表情像是要上战场。

    “我知道。”

    “第一项品质赛，占四成。把你最好的手艺拿出来。”

    “明白。”

    赵铁手拍了一下他的肩膀，力气大得陈青山往前趄了一步。

    “走。”

    器峰演武场。

    陈青山到的时候，场子里已经黑压压站了一片人。废器处理组、炼器学徒组、外门候选弟子，少说也有七八十号。三三两两聚在一起，嗡嗡嗡地小声议论。

    “听说了吗？这回大考前三直接升外门。”

    “废话，哪回不是？关键是你得有那个本事。”

    “我？我陪跑的。倒是废器处理组那个陈青山，听说最近精铁纯度涨了不少。”

    “涨了多少？”

    “八成多。”

    “扯淡吧，一个杂役？”

    陈青山从他们旁边走过去，脸上什么表情都没有。

    演武场正中间搭了个高台，三面挂着器峰的旗帜。高台上坐了三个人，中间那位头发花白，身穿青色道袍，气息深沉得像一口古井。

    赵铁手压低声音：“周长老。筑基中期。器峰副峰主，亲自主持大考。”

    陈青山点头，没说话。

    他目光往远处一扫。

    演武场东侧的高墙上，站着一个人。白衣，长发，木别。

    柳如烟。

    陈青山心里一紧。

    她不是考核官，站那么高，摆明了是来看热闹的。但看谁的热闹？

    大概率是他的。

    上次静室被审的事还没翻篇。这女人盯着他不放。

    陈青山收回目光，低下头，走到废器处理组的队列里站好。

    赵铁手凑过来：“看到柳首席了？”

    “看到了。”

    “别管她。好好考。”

    “嗯。”

    高台上，周长老站起来。

    全场安静。

    “器峰每季度大考，老规矩。三项。精铁品质，占四成。熔炼速度，占三成。实战比试，占三成。综合排名前三者，升外门弟子。”

    他的声音不大，但每个字都清清楚楚送进在场所有人的耳朵里。筑基中期的修为压在那里，没人敢出声。

    “第一项，精铁品质赛。”

    周长老一挥手，执事们抬上来几十口小熔炉，一字排开。每口炉子前面放着一堆灰黑色的废渣。

    “每人十斤废渣。当场熔炼。一个时辰为限。三位长老评判纯度与品质。”

    “开始。”

    陈青山走到自己的熔炉前，低头看了看那堆废渣。

    灰黑色，杂质多，品相一般。

    他伸手抓了一把，搓了搓。

    心里有了数。

    十斤废渣，正常手法，杂质含量大概三成。要把纯度拉到八成以上，至少得熔炼三遍。拉到九成，得四遍甚至五遍，费时费力，还容易被人盯上。

    他不想太高。

    上次柳青霜查出他九成二的事儿，他还记着呢。

    但也不能太低。七成以下的精铁，杂役里的废物水平，过不了考核。

    所以——

    八成三。

    高一分扎眼，低一分丢人。八成三，优秀但不扎眼。

    陈青山蹲下来，把废渣倒进炉中，催动灵力。

    火焰升起。

    这一个月他天天用公用熔炉，手感磨出来了。火候大小、灵力多少、时间长短，全凭手感拿捏。

    废渣在炉中融化，杂质一点点分离。

    第一遍。熔成铁水，去渣。

    第二遍。精炼，杂质再减。

    第三遍。收火，调纯度。

    旁边的杂役一个个满头大汗，灵力催得凶猛，生怕炼不出好东西。有个炼器学徒组的甚至用了四遍熔炼，多花了一倍时间。

    陈青山不紧不慢。

    火候稳，灵力匀，手不抖。

    第三遍收火的时候，他特意在最后一刻多加了一丝灵力——不多，刚好把纯度从八成五压到八成三。
content_en:
Twelve days passed in a flash.

    Chen Qingshan did nothing in the last few days. Work normally during the day and close the door at night to rest, suppress your cultivation, and maintain your condition. The two boxes he moved the day after tomorrow were still lying quietly in the sea of ​​​​consciousness, and he was not in a hurry to deal with them.

    The day of the big exam.

    "Today's big exam, don't let your hair slip."

    Before dawn, Zhao Tieshou stood at the door of Chen Qingshan, holding a kettle in his hand, with an expression on his face as if he was about to go to the battlefield.

    "I know."

    "The first quality competition accounts for 40%. Show off your best skills."

    "Understood."

    Zhao Tie patted his shoulder with such force that Chen Qingshan staggered forward.

    "Let's go."

    Qifeng martial arts arena.

    When Chen Qingshan arrived, the place was already filled with people. There are at least 70 or 80 candidates in the scrap weapon processing group, weapon refining apprentice group, and outer sect candidate disciples. People gathered together in twos and threes, discussing in low voices.

    "Have you heard? This time the top three in the exam will be directly promoted to the outer sect."

    "Nonsense, what time is it not? The key is that you have to have that ability."

    "Me? I'm running with you. It's Chen Qingshan from the waste disposal team. I heard that the purity of refined iron has increased a lot recently."

    "How much has it increased?"

    "More than 80%."

    "Nonsense, a handyman?"

    Chen Qingshan walked past them with no expression on his face.

    A high platform was set up in the middle of the martial arts arena, with Qifeng's flags hung on three sides. There were three people sitting on the high platform. The one in the middle had gray hair and was wearing a green robe. His breath was as deep as an ancient well.

    Zhao Tieshou lowered his voice: "Elder Zhou. In the middle stage of foundation building. The deputy peak master of Qi Peak will personally preside over the exam."

    Chen Qingshan nodded and said nothing.

    He glanced far away.

    There is a person standing on the high wall on the east side of the martial arts arena. White clothes, long hair, wooden farewell.

    Liu Ruyan.

    Chen Qingshan's heart tightened.

    She was not the assessor. Standing so high, it was obvious that she was here to watch the fun. But whose excitement is it to watch?

    Most likely it's his.

    The story of the last trial in the quiet room has not been over yet. The woman stared at him.

    Chen Qingshan withdrew his gaze, lowered his head, and walked to stand in the queue of the waste disposal team.

    Zhao Tieshou came over and said, "Have you seen Chief Liu?"

    "I saw it."

    "Leave her alone. Take the exam well."

    "Yeah."

    On the high platform, Elder Zhou stood up.

    The whole place was quiet.

    "The Qi Peak exams are held every quarter. The old rules are: three items. The quality of refined iron accounts for 40%. The smelting speed accounts for 30%. The actual combat test accounts for 30%. The top three in the overall ranking will be promoted to outer disciples."

    His voice was not loud, but every word was clearly heard by everyone present. The cultivation level in the middle stage of foundation building was there, and no one dared to speak out.

    "The first event is the refined iron quality competition."

    Elder Zhou waved his hand, and the deacons brought up dozens of small furnaces and lined them up. In front of each stove was a pile of gray-black waste.

    "Ten kilograms of waste per person. Smelted on the spot. Limited to one hour. Three elders will judge the purity and quality."

    "Start."

    Chen Qingshan walked to his furnace and looked down at the pile of waste.

    Gray-black color, many impurities, average quality.

    He reached out, grabbed a handful, and rubbed it.

    I have a good idea.

    Ten pounds of waste residue, using normal techniques, contains about 30% impurities. To increase the purity to over 80%, it must be smelted at least three times. If you reach 90%, you have to do it four or even five times, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive, and you can easily be targeted.

    He didn't want to get too high.

    Last time Liu Qingshuang found out about 90% of his affairs, he still remembered it.

    But it can't be too low. Refined iron with less than 70% is a waste level among the handymen and cannot pass the assessment.

    So——

    Eighty-three percent.

    The higher one is eye-catching, the lower one is embarrassing. Eighty-three percent, excellent but not eye-catching.

    Chen Qingshan squatted down, poured the waste residue into the furnace, and activated his spiritual power.

    Flames rise.

    This month he used the public furnace every day, which made his hand feel better. The size of the fire, the amount of spiritual power, and the length of time all depend on the feel of the hand.

    The waste slag is melted in the furnace, and the impurities are separated little by little.

    First time. Melt into molten iron and remove slag.

    Second time. Refining reduces impurities.

    The third time. Turn off the heat and adjust the purity.

    The handymen next to me were all sweating profusely, their spiritual energy was so intense that they were afraid that they wouldn't be able to produce anything good. One of the weapon-smelting apprentice group even used four times of smelting, which took twice as long.

    Chen Qingshan took his time.

    The fire is stable, the spiritual power is even, and the hands do not shake.

    When he closed the fire for the third time, he deliberately added a little more spiritual power at the last moment - not much, just enough to reduce the purity from 85% to 83%.
